text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Umm, I'll have the regular... What about you, Gran? Wait, there are 10 of us, maybe we shouldn't order individually?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, good idea! Let's get the orders together!
—Who wants regular! Hands up—!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
...W-Well then.
I'll have the same thing...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: (The register was crowded so I ordered the same thing for everyone, but... did she want to drink something else, I wonder...?)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...I really should have listened to what they had to say.
